title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: The position request
hook: A parent asks you to let their child pitch.
intro: Their child wants to be in the circle.
You see them at second base.
statement: Position requests are often about a kid's hopes.
q1: Do you give the player a chance to try it —
q2: or explain why they fit where they are?
t1: Both can work. But these talks go better
t2: when you ask the player too.
cta: Coaches — how do you handle position requests?
ctaLines: Try it in practice. Explain the role. Ask the kid.
Give a try or hold the line?
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A parent asks you to let their child pitch.
Their child wants to be in the circle. You see them at second base.
Position requests are often about a kid's hopes.
Give them a try or explain the role. Both can work.
How do you handle position requests? Share your habit in the comments.
